+#elif defined(PTRACE_GETREGS_REQ)
+ if (ptrace(PTRACE_GETREGS_REQ, pid, NULL, user) < 0) {

+ return true;

+ print_warning("ptrace(PTRACE_GETREGS, ...) not supported\n");
